topics.title: A rollback blocked by Git's index lock says so

suggestion.reason: PR hub bug fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.title: PR review comments stay inside the pull request's hunks

topics.title: Repos with only a local git remote are no longer grouped together

suggestion.reason: This fixes terminal clipboard and multiplexer misbehavior.

suggestion.reason: PR hub UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.title: PR Code tab keeps its scroll when a turn finishes

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost user input in the pending-question panel, which f5 has. Reimplement in f5's pending-request hook.

suggestion.reason: Small UX fix in the Files panel.

topics.title: Image viewer close button stays clear of the window controls

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong preview viewport sizes in f5's preview browser when the desktop app is zoomed.

suggestion.reason: Server and desktop reliability fix for packaged asset hosting.

topics.title: Static files are served when the platform cannot open file handles

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in the preview browser picker, if the fork's picker numbers annotations with a counter.

topics.title: Connections refreshes stale desktop endpoints when reopened

suggestion.reason: The Device panel is an upstream devices and simulators feature.

topics.summary: Pending device actions and their errors are scoped to the thread that started them.
topics.title: Device panel results stay in the thread that started them

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile diagnostics screen reads the build number from expo-application.
topics.title: Mobile crash report shows the store build number

suggestion.reason: OpenCode threads currently get images only as attachment paths, so the model can miss them. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: Supported local images are sent as native prompt files, keeping the attachment-path text. A steer stopped during file lookup is rejected cleanly.
topics.title: OpenCode turns and steers send pasted images to the model

suggestion.reason: Shows the real reason for Cursor turn failures in the thread and to delegating agents.

topics.summary: Failure messages include the SDK's error message, code and status, such as Model Blocked or resource_exhausted, instead of 'Provider turn failed.' Delegating parents see the same reason.
topics.title: Failed Cursor turns show Cursor's reason

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible rendering bug in timeline Mermaid diagrams, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The final DOMPurify pass now allows the KaTeX MathML elements and attributes that Mermaid emits, so $$...$$ labels are no longer blank. annotation, maction and mglyph stay stripped.
topics.title: Math labels in Mermaid diagrams render instead of empty boxes

suggestion.reason: Clearer failure messages for providers f5 has. Reimplement in f5's provider layer, not upstream's provider-core.

topics.summary: Provider errors carry an optional reason. The failure banner shows fixed wording for an unreadable attachment or a still-active previous turn instead of a generic failure. Adapters mark these cases.
topics.title: Turn-start failures say why: unreadable attachment or previous turn still running

suggestion.reason: Relay push service only.

topics.summary: The relay moves environmentId, threadId and deepLink under body, so Expo exposes them as notification data on iOS.
topics.title: iOS push notifications open their thread again

suggestion.reason: Fixes OpenCode models missing from the picker. This needs a reimplementation in f5's OpenCode provider layer.

topics.summary: Requires two matching non-empty catalog reads, within the existing 5-second limit, before caching. A cold OpenCode server can no longer leave a partial model list in the picker.
topics.title: OpenCode model catalog settles before it is cached

suggestion.reason: A git diff correctness fix that affects fork-based workflows in f5.

topics.summary: Branches with gh-merge-base set to a remote ref compare against that exact remote ref. Unrelated upstream commits no longer show up as feature changes.
topics.title: Changes honor a configured remote merge base such as upstream/main

suggestion.reason: Fixes storage cleanup coverage. Keep f5's storageCleanup.enabled default.

topics.summary: Cleanup reads active and archived threads in one snapshot, so archived checkouts follow the cleanup rules and count as worktree sharers in removal rechecks.
topics.title: Storage cleanup includes worktrees of archived threads

suggestion.reason: Fixes snoozed threads waking too early in f5. Reimplement it in f5's projection and client state, not in orchestration-v2 or client-runtime.

topics.summary: PR sync, PR-link updates and active reordering keep the thread's activity timestamp. A failure wakes the thread only based on the failed run's completion time, not on later runtime metadata.
topics.title: Snoozed threads no longer wake early after background updates

suggestion.reason: A small settings UX fix.

topics.summary: In Settings → Providers, the model name gets the available width first and the slug truncates. A focusable tooltip shows the full name and slug.
topics.title: Provider model names are no longer cut off by long slugs

suggestion.reason: Fixes a false Unavailable status for the OpenCode provider.

topics.summary: The OpenCode --version probe timeout goes from 4s to 10s, so wrapped installs that start slowly cold are detected.
topics.title: Slow OpenCode wrappers no longer show as unavailable

suggestion.reason: Fixes settings that carried over to the wrong model.

topics.summary: Project and checkout model selections now replace the saved options instead of merging with them, for the default, text-generation, writer and review-guide models.
topics.title: Changing a project's model drops the old model's options

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong completion state in the Claude provider.

topics.summary: Goal completion also checks live subagent work by task type. Agent and workflow tasks defer completion, and an unknown task type defers it too, so clearing the goal can't discard work still running.
topics.title: Claude /goal no longer reads as complete while a background subagent runs

suggestion.reason: Fixes an unwanted background watch on forked threads in f5's PR hub and fork flow.

topics.summary: Forking a thread keeps its PR links but removes each link's watch, so the fork does not silently start watching the parent's pull requests.
topics.title: Forked threads no longer inherit pull request watches

suggestion.reason: An observability improvement in serverLogger, which exists in f5.

topics.summary: The console-pretty logger renders any Cause passed as a log field with Cause.pretty, so log lines show why a failure happened.
topics.title: Server logs print the full cause instead of [Object]

suggestion.reason: Fixes session import of Codex threads, a feature f5 has.

topics.summary: The import scanner ignores Codex session_meta records whose source is a subagent. Child rollouts no longer appear as separate threads or use up the recent-thread budget.
topics.title: Session import skips Codex subagent rollouts

suggestion.reason: Desktop deep-link fix for Linux AppImage users, if f5 registers a URL handler.

topics.summary: Older xdg-open fails to look up a quoted Exec path, so callbacks opened in a browser. The desktop entry now quotes the path only when it contains reserved characters.
topics.title: Linux URL handler quotes the Exec path only when it must

suggestion.reason: Responsiveness fix in the server preview browser.

topics.summary: Viewer navigation and history no longer block the input queue. Outstanding navigations are tracked and drained before an agent handoff.
topics.title: Browser input stays responsive during slow navigation

suggestion.reason: Measurable storage/perf improvement. It needs reimplementing in f5's OpenCode adapter if that adapter also shares sessions across threads.

topics.summary: setSessionStatus returns early when status and lastError are unchanged. Before, each repeat wrote one event per attached thread, which made up about 91% of session events on busy instances.
topics.title: OpenCode stops persisting unchanged session status updates

suggestion.reason: Provider bug fix that causes T3 tools to be lost. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: Each turn re-adds the T3 MCP server, because OpenCode drops runtime MCP servers when it evicts an idle Location. The orchestration instructions follow that turn's add result.
topics.title: OpenCode threads keep T3 tools after an idle project is evicted

suggestion.question: Does f5 have the server-side html_preview headless Chrome renderer?
suggestion.reason: Makes html_preview failures easier to diagnose, but only if the fork has the html render tool. Its paths are missing in the fork.

topics.summary: HtmlRenderBrowserError now includes the exit code or signal when headless Chrome exits before rendering.
topics.title: HTML preview errors report the headless browser's exit code or signal

suggestion.reason: Prevents lost messages during Stop. Needs reimplementing in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Steer, restart and queued-message promotion are rejected when the persisted Stop marker shows the run is stopping. A plain send queues instead, so the message is not lost.
topics.title: A message promoted into a stopping run stays queued

suggestion.reason: Fixes a small usage UI bug. Port the web part only.

topics.summary: Web limit bars look up the driver in PROVIDER_PRESENTATION, so Cursor, Grok and OpenCode bars no longer fall back to the foreground color. The mobile changes don't apply to f5.
topics.title: Usage limit bars use each provider's chart color

suggestion.reason: User-visible bug fix in Open in and file preview.

topics.summary: OpenInPicker takes a revealFileManager prop. The file preview sets it, so choosing the file manager sends reveal: true instead of opening the file in its default app.
topics.title: Open in → Finder from the file preview reveals the file

suggestion.reason: Devices and simulators only.

topics.summary: Pointer presses with a button other than the primary one are no longer forwarded to the device as touches.
topics.title: Flat Device viewport ignores right and middle clicks

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain for f5's orchestrator MCP tools on long threads.

topics.summary: An empty turn-item filter list now skips the SQLite query that would match no rows. This saves 15 to 280 ms per MCP projection read on long threads.
topics.title: MCP thread reads skip the turn-item scan when the filter is empty

suggestion.reason: Fixes clipped rows in the command palette, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The command palette's list panel becomes a flex column with min-h-0, and the Repository header no longer shrinks. The last environment or option row can be reached again.
topics.title: New Project options scroll above the footer

suggestion.reason: Fixes a checkpoint bug that breaks the user's checkout. f5 has checkpoints.

topics.summary: Checkpoint capture writes its scratch index with core.splitIndex=false and sharedIndexExpire=never. Before, it could expire the sharedindex file and break every git command in repos using splitIndex.
topics.title: Checkpoints no longer delete a shared split index the repo still uses

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong model labels on subagent cards for f5's Claude provider.

topics.summary: The model snapshot ignores '<synthetic>', the model name Claude puts on its own usage-limit and API-error notices. Subagent cards keep showing the real model.
topics.title: Claude subagents keep their model after a usage-limit notice

suggestion.reason: UX fix in the Files panel.

topics.summary: When a tree search has no matches, the Files panel shows an empty-result message instead of Pierre's fallback to the full unfiltered tree.
topics.title: Files panel shows 'No matching files.' for an empty search

suggestion.reason: Checkpoint diff bug that f5 can hit. Reimplement in f5's checkpoint query.

topics.summary: Adjacent-turn diffs use the ready checkpoint at the previous ordinal in the same scope, even when it came from a stopped run or has no run. This fixes 'Failed to load turn diff'.
topics.title: The turn after a stopped turn shows its diff again

suggestion.reason: A small UX fix for the new-thread headline, if the fork has the draft hero.

topics.summary: Replaces the fixed max-w-64 on the project selector with a width based on the available space. The project name and '?' are kept together on one line.
topics.title: Draft headline truncates the project name only when it has to

suggestion.reason: The same flicker can happen in f5's thread shell state. Reimplement the fix outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The shell reducer keeps a thread's existing PR links when a reconnect snapshot changes other metadata. Before, PR badges disappeared until the deferred link data loaded.
topics.title: PR links stay visible on reconnect when thread metadata changes

suggestion.reason: Gives agents an accurate error from the preview browser tools, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The close tool returns the broker's typed error, such as agentMismatch, instead of a generic orchestration_error.
topics.title: t3_preview_close reports the server browser's refusal

suggestion.reason: Changes only the Tiptap rich-text composer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: A plugin tracks typed backtick pairs. Moving the caret past the closing tick applies the code mark instead of leaving literal backticks.
topics.title: Text typed between backticks becomes inline code in the rich composer

suggestion.question: Does f5 ship the SnapShot window-capture feature and its GNOME extension?
suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop compatibility issue, but only if the fork ships the SnapShot GNOME extension. Its paths are missing in the fork.

topics.summary: Adds '51' to the extension's shell-version list and bumps its version, so it loads on GNOME 51.
topics.title: SnapShot GNOME extension supports GNOME Shell 51

suggestion.question: Does f5 keep the Device panel and SSH device hosts, so device-host fixes should be ported?
suggestion.reason: SshDeviceHost belongs to the device subsystem, which f5 lacks.

topics.summary: The tunnel spawn disables ControlMaster, ControlPath and ControlPersist, so it stops reconnect-looping and leaking listeners until ephemeral ports run out.
topics.title: SSH device-host tunnels no longer inherit ControlMaster

suggestion.reason: Device hub SSH hosts are part of the devices and simulators subsystem.

topics.summary: The tunnel runs a remote stdin reader with piped stdin. When the server exits, the reader gets EOF and SSH exits instead of being left orphaned.
topics.title: Device-host SSH tunnels exit when the server dies

suggestion.reason: Fix to the scheduled-tasks subsystem, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Worktree requests for Scratch projects are normalized to root, so scheduled tasks without a project no longer fail on Git operations.
topics.title: Scheduled tasks for No project launch in a scratch folder

suggestion.reason: Fixes MCP orchestration tools that disagree with the PR link data.

topics.summary: t3_thread_list and t3_thread_read add a pullRequests array of visible links with host, repo, number, url, source and state, matching list_thread_pull_requests. Orchestrators no longer see null for linked threads.
topics.title: MCP thread list and read report every linked pull request

suggestion.reason: UX fix to the composer usage-limit notice, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Resume at reset and Snooze until reset failures are reported with an error toast, so the composer notice keeps its one-row layout and stays readable.
topics.title: Usage-limit recovery errors show as toasts instead of crushing the banner

suggestion.reason: This fixes a reliability bug in the preview browser on desktop: agent browser calls on a long-open tab can fail.

topics.summary: The desktop preview manager now listens for the debugger detach event. It releases the stale control session and detaches the server tab, so the next agent browser call reattaches instead of failing until the page is reloaded.
topics.title: Preview tab reattaches after Chromium drops its debugger

suggestion.reason: Fixes a notification bug f5 users can hit.

topics.summary: playNotificationSound skips a sound while the same sound is still playing, so bursts no longer stack into loud, distorted audio.
topics.title: Threads finishing together play one completion sound

suggestion.reason: f5 has thread snooze. The symptom can occur there. Reimplement in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: The settlement event now clears snoozedUntil and snoozedAt, so server confirmation no longer puts the thread back into Snoozed after the user settles it.
topics.title: Settling a snoozed thread clears its snooze on the server too

suggestion.reason: Fixes invisible caret in inline diff/file comments if f5 has editable file previews with comments.

topics.summary: Inline comment annotations restore visible caret and selection overridden by Pierre's editable surface.
topics.title: Show native caret and selection in file comments

suggestion.reason: Device hub and agent device tool settings are a devices-only subsystem.

topics.summary: The Integrations update popover shows the server error message. Failed npm installs report their exit code instead of a generic network hint.
topics.title: Device tool update failures show the server error instead of network advice

suggestion.reason: Server-browser pages render without text on minimal Linux hosts. This fixes that preview browser bug.

topics.summary: Setup checks for a usable font with fc-match. Without root, it reports the missing fonts and no longer says the host is ready. As root with apt, it installs fontconfig and fonts-liberation.
topics.title: t3 browser setup detects and installs missing fonts
fix(mobile): Chinese input no longer breaks before a skill pill on iOS (#17614)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading action in provider settings. The affected files exist in the fork.

topics.summary: The update command is hidden when the installed version is already the package's latest, as with OpenCode 1.x when 2.x is recommended.
topics.title: Settings stops offering a provider update that cannot clear a limited-support warning
fix(mobile): prevent environment row taps from swallowing switches (#17677)

suggestion.reason: A user-visible preview browser capability. The default is unchanged.

topics.summary: Settings → Integrations → Browser gets a Search engine picker with presets and a custom %s template. Invalid templates fall back to DuckDuckGo, which stays the default.
topics.title: Choose the in-app browser's search engine

suggestion.reason: T3 Connect and relay only.

topics.summary: The CLI warns to deregister from the T3 Connect page when unlink or logout cannot revoke the relay record.
topics.title: t3 connect unlink warns when the relay record is left behind

suggestion.reason: Usage bug fix for Antigravity instances.

topics.summary: Usage roots are resolved from each instance's ANTIGRAVITY_DATA_DIR, with the default-instance fallback kept, so histories of other instances are counted.
topics.title: Antigravity usage reads each instance's data directory

suggestion.reason: f5 has queued messages and usage-limit resume; if its orchestration orders the transcript similarly, the symptom can occur. Reimplement in f5's layer.

topics.summary: Queued runs started after a resume get a newer run ordinal so the transcript order matches execution order.
topics.title: Queued messages render after a resume turn that ran before them

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in the composer approval panel, a file that exists in f5.

topics.summary: Command, file and permission approval details use pre-wrap with overflow-wrap anywhere and a 160px scroll area, so long commands no longer require scrolling sideways.
topics.title: Long approval commands wrap inside the composer

suggestion.reason: This only targets the Tiptap composer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Removes the top and bottom margins of the first and last blocks in .composer-tiptap, so a leading list or quote is not clipped in the one-line composer.
topics.title: Collapsed composer centers drafts that start with a list

suggestion.reason: Fixes images going missing during composer copy and paste, which f5 users can hit.

topics.summary: The files behind the latest composer copy are kept for the browser tab and imported through the normal attachment path. Pastes no longer lose images whose upload was still running or whose source attachment was removed.
topics.title: Images copied from unsent drafts survive paste

suggestion.reason: Small accessibility fix in the new-thread hero, if f5 has the same headline.

topics.summary: Removes the explicit aria-label from the new-thread heading, which hid the inline project picker from NVDA in browse mode.
topics.title: NVDA browse mode can reach the new-thread project picker again

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading storage-cleanup estimate in a subsystem f5 has. f5's storageCleanup.enabled default stays as it is.

topics.summary: Worktree size measurement skips files with more than one hardlink and counts allocated blocks for the rest. Removing a worktree whose dependencies are hardlinked from a shared store no longer reports space that was not actually freed.
topics.title: Storage cleanup no longer counts hardlinked files as recovered space

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for the OpenCode provider. Reimplement outside packages/provider-*.

topics.summary: Classifies a SQLITE_BUSY startup exit as databaseLocked and retries up to three times, 250 ms apart, instead of failing the new thread.
topics.title: OpenCode startup retries when the shared database is locked

suggestion.reason: Small preview browser bug fix in shared code that f5 has.

topics.summary: URL normalization uses an anchored scheme check, so localhost:3000/?next=https://… opens the local app instead of starting a search.
topics.title: Preview addresses that contain another URL open instead of searching

suggestion.reason: A terminal input bug. Port it if f5's terminal maps keys only by physical code; the Ghostty files are not in the fork.

topics.summary: When the physical key code is empty or not mapped, the Ghostty key mapping falls back to the logical key, so Backspace works on Android browsers.
topics.title: Terminal handles Backspace when Android leaves out the key code

suggestion.reason: A UX fix on f5's Usage page.

topics.summary: Limit bars and legend buttons share one popover, which moves between segments instead of opening a second one. It closes when its account or window disappears.
topics.title: Usage limits show one account popover at a time

suggestion.reason: This only affects pairing links for other devices, which falls under pairing and remote access that f5 does not ship.

topics.summary: The desktop advertises an address on a normal interface before bridges, VPN tunnels and VM adapters when it builds local network pairing links.
topics.title: Local network pairing links prefer real LAN interfaces over bridges and tunnels

suggestion.reason: Timeline status bug in subagent rows. f5 has Claude subagents.

topics.summary: When a failed Claude background subagent is resumed, its parent notification row shows the live status instead of keeping a red Failed badge.
topics.title: Resumed subagent notification row shows running instead of failed

suggestion.reason: Gives agents in f5's orchestration MCP accurate delegation diagnostics.

topics.summary: For disabled instances, MCP capabilities and delegation report only the disabled reason, not placeholder install, health or auth failures.
topics.title: Disabled providers no longer report missing executables in MCP capabilities

suggestion.reason: Provider settings UX fix that applies to f5's update notices.

topics.summary: Manual-only installs (mise, node_modules, unofficial Muse binaries) get their own wording that names the install, instead of promising a Settings update action that does not exist.
topics.title: Provider update notices explain how to update installs T3 cannot update

suggestion.reason: Fixes missed PR watch updates for Forgejo forges.

topics.summary: The Forgejo comment decoder keeps updated_at and exposes editedAt, so the watch evaluator notices when a bot edits an existing comment.
topics.title: Forgejo PR watches wake for edited comments

suggestion.reason: Keyboard bug in the right panel tabs, which f5 has (the path exists).

topics.summary: The shortcut blocker now matches only open or closing popups, so closed keepMounted popovers no longer swallow launcher letters and Mod+T.
topics.title: Right-panel launcher letters work while a closed menu stays mounted

suggestion.reason: Crash fix in the PR and diff file tree.

topics.summary: Colliding files get an internal alias in the Pierre diff file tree. Selection and reveal map back to the real paths, and the original icons are kept.
topics.title: Diffs with a file and folder at the same path no longer crash the tree

suggestion.reason: Fixes cross-thread interference in the preview browser. The files exist in f5.

topics.summary: The preview broker's assignment key now includes the thread id, so threads sharing a Codex/OpenCode session no longer share a current tab, tab budget or ownership.
topics.title: Preview browser tabs are isolated per thread when threads share a provider session

suggestion.reason: Preview browser bug fix.

topics.summary: The idle sweep only closes headless agent tabs, so a desktop tab the user is reading is no longer closed.
topics.title: Desktop-rendered preview tabs are kept out of idle cleanup

suggestion.reason: This is client-runtime environment supervision for multi-environment and T3 Connect handoffs. Neither exists in f5.

topics.summary: Enabled environments start in the connecting state, and an unavailable error from a session that is no longer current keeps the query pending. Usage no longer flashes 'cannot report usage' over T3 Connect.
topics.title: Queries stay pending while an environment connection hands off

suggestion.reason: Only affects devices and simulators.

topics.summary: Starts expo-device-hub with --platform android off macOS, so the Device panel no longer shows an xcrun error.
topics.title: Device hub skips Apple simulator discovery on non-Mac hosts

suggestion.reason: Both the fix and the ownership race that causes the bug live in upstream orchestration-v2's Orchestrator, which f5 doesn't have.

topics.summary: On Stop, settlement now reconciles the interrupted provider thread's background roster even when a live session exists, unless that session's probe still reports work. A newer failed start that advanced provider-thread ownership no longer leaves a stale running entry.
topics.title: Stop no longer leaves a killed background command showing as running

suggestion.reason: Observability improvement for the usage hub source f5 has.

topics.summary: CLIProxyAPI management failures now report the HTTP status, a timeout or the Node error code. For untrusted certificates, the message suggests NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
topics.title: Limits hub failures name the TLS, HTTP or timeout cause
fix(mobile): usage chart legend wraps instead of pushing the end date off-screen (#18203)

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong thread settlement, which can happen in f5's settlement logic. Reimplement inside f5's layers.

topics.summary: Settle-on-merge ignores links made after their PR had already merged or closed. A thread asked to merge PRs no longer settles while it is still working.
topics.title: Threads don't settle after merging PRs that were already merged when linked

suggestion.reason: Approval UX improvement for the Codex provider. Reimplement in f5's Codex adapter.

topics.summary: Keeps the paths and change kinds from item/started for each item in the active turn, so modern file-change approvals show filenames instead of a generic prompt.
topics.title: Codex file-change approvals list the files they change

suggestion.reason: This is a small settings UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The agent browser access row moves into the existing Browser section of Integrations settings. The duplicate integrations category is removed from project defaults.
topics.title: Integrations settings show one Browser section

suggestion.reason: Windows clone bug that f5 can hit. Reimplement in f5's clone service.

topics.title: Cloning into a new folder directly under a drive root works

topics.title: Muse turns stopped by the subscription quota show Limited, not failed

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug where a settings choice was ignored in git actions and the inspector.

topics.summary: The Changes row and the file_change inspector now use the diff-addition and diff-deletion color tokens, so they follow the Blue & orange setting.
topics.title: Diff counts follow the selected diff color palette

suggestion.reason: Only affects upstream's devices and simulators tooling.

topics.title: agent-device no longer launches the desktop app from Codex shells

suggestion.reason: Fixes skills disappearing from the composer for f5's providers.

topics.summary: The registry keeps successful skill scans even when a provider's health status is error, so Codex, OpenCode and Pi skills stay in the $ and / menus.
topics.title: Workspace skills stay in the composer when provider health checks fail

suggestion.reason: Fixes review-guide content in the PR hub.

topics.title: Review guides in a fork checkout cover only the pull request's change

suggestion.reason: Tiny sidebar visual fix; apply if f5's sidebar has the same padded empty thread list.

topics.title: Collapsed projects no longer leave a border stub

suggestion.reason: OpenCode provider fix. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter, since packages/provider-opencode does not exist here.

topics.title: OpenCode Go quota and rate-limit stops show as usage limits

fix(mobile): preserve server matches in file search (#18388)

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost draft text in the composer.

topics.title: Compressed image chips stay in their original draft

suggestion.reason: A small UX improvement on f5's desktop update surfaces.

topics.summary: The desktop update state carries the disabled reason. The sidebar update pill's tooltip and accessible label, and Settings → About, show it.
topics.title: Disabled desktop update controls explain why

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong failure marker and improves performance. f5's work-log derivation probably has the same scan. Reimplement in f5's layer, since client-runtime does not exist.

topics.summary: Work-log presentation no longer runs the tool-failure regexes over reasoning text. This speeds up long-thread derivations and stops reasoning prose such as "exit code 2 is expected" from being marked as a failed tool.
topics.title: Reasoning rows skip the tool-failure text scan

suggestion.reason: A performance improvement for PR link resolution in chat and sidebar, if f5 has the equivalent resolver.

topics.summary: Caches normalized pull request keys per link object in a WeakMap, so resolving chains no longer re-parses URLs several times per render.
topics.title: Pull request chains parse each link's URL once

suggestion.reason: This is a rollback and fork bug in the Claude provider, and f5's Claude adapter can hit it. Reimplement it in f5's adapter layer.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter now moves its resume cursor only on main-thread assistant frames. Before, a turn whose last frame came from a subagent stored a sidechain uuid, and rollback or fork then failed with 'No message found with message.uuid'.
topics.title: Reverting a Claude thread to a subagent-only turn no longer breaks it

suggestion.reason: Fixes duplicate PR watch wake-ups. Reimplement in f5's PR watch layer.

topics.summary: When a watch ends, the state it last reported is kept as endedWatch, so a new watch only wakes the thread for changes it has not reported yet.
topics.title: Re-watching a pull request no longer repeats news the thread already got

suggestion.reason: Device panel only.

topics.summary: The device hub proxy drops x-forwarded-proto, and fold controls renew their access when it is rejected.
topics.title: Android fold controls work over T3 Connect

suggestion.reason: Small visual fix to branch picker, a git surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Wrapper becomes shrinkable flex column with equal vertical padding so last branch isn't clipped.
topics.title: Branch picker keeps space below the last branch

suggestion.reason: A small UX improvement that makes composer shortcuts easier to discover.

topics.summary: The environment and workspace selector tooltips now add their bound shortcut in the 'label · shortcut' format the model picker uses.
topics.title: Composer host and workspace tooltips show their keyboard shortcuts

suggestion.reason: Thread loading bug that can occur if f5's thread history paging uses a similar byte budget. Reimplement in f5's layer.

topics.summary: The byte-windowed thread projection reserves at least half the page budget for rows, so large checkpoint file lists no longer shrink the first window to one row behind 'Load earlier turns'.
topics.title: Agent-driven threads keep recent rows when checkpoint data is large

suggestion.reason: Measurable idle CPU improvement in f5's usage-limit recovery.

topics.summary: The recovery-candidate query is limited to threads that have a usage_limit error item. This removes about 40 ms of synchronous SQL every 5 seconds while idle.
topics.title: Usage-limit sweep stops sorting every run on each tick

suggestion.reason: A measurable rendering performance gain in the sidebar, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Adds a useNowSecond hook: one timeout aligned to whole seconds replaces a 1-second interval in every working sidebar row. This cuts repaints and renderer CPU while several chats are streaming.
topics.title: Sidebar working timers share one clock

suggestion.reason: Terminal file links fail to match these paths on Windows.

topics.summary: Terminal link detection matches relative backslash paths and quoted paths that contain spaces, keeping line and column suffixes. Windows home syntax resolves against the environment's cwd.
topics.title: Terminal recognizes Windows backslash and quoted file links

suggestion.reason: Restores desktop zoom input methods that the custom zoom menu items had dropped.

topics.summary: Adds hidden menu accelerators for numpad +, - and 0, and handles Ctrl+wheel on the main window through a shared zoom helper.
topics.title: Keypad shortcuts and Ctrl+wheel zoom the desktop app

suggestion.reason: A measurable speedup in terminal history handling that runs on every PTY output event. Reimplement it in the fork's terminal manager.

topics.summary: sanitizeTerminalHistoryChunk now appends each printable run up to the next escape sequence in one step. Before, it appended one character at a time, which slowed down every PTY output event with color.
topics.title: Colored terminal output appends printable runs as one slice

suggestion.reason: A fork that publishes its own releases needs update links pointing at those releases.

topics.summary: Exposes T3CODE_DESKTOP_UPDATE_REPOSITORY, with GITHUB_REPOSITORY as fallback, to the web build. Version and release-history links use that repository instead of hardcoding pingdotgg/t3code.
topics.title: Desktop update links follow the configured update repository

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Claude provider behavior that users can see.

topics.summary: Claude informational system messages that are not info level become system notices. The duplicate result-text fallback is skipped, so a blocked UserPromptSubmit hook no longer looks like a swallowed prompt.
topics.title: A Claude hook that blocks a prompt now shows its reason

suggestion.reason: Small composer visual polish. The ComposerControl file differs in the fork.

topics.title: Composer control labels center with their icons

suggestion.reason: Fixes a slow localStorage leak in the PR hub, which f5 has.

topics.summary: PR detail snapshots in localStorage are tracked in a recent-keys index, and older ones are removed past 20. This stops unbounded storage growth.
topics.title: Stored pull request detail snapshots keep only the 20 most recent

topics.title: Scrolling a huge thread's history no longer hits React's update-depth limit

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: iOS sheet headers replace the Cancel and Done text buttons with icon buttons.
topics.title: Mobile sheets close with an X and confirm with a checkmark

suggestion.reason: Fixes a thread that can stay stuck for an hour in f5's Codex provider and queue. Reimplement it in f5's layers.

topics.summary: When a Codex root turn fails, its terminal event is emitted right away instead of waiting for native subagents to finish. The run ends, queued messages can proceed, and the UI stops showing 'Working'.
topics.title: A failed Codex turn no longer traps the queue behind its subagents

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale-closure bugs in surfaces f5 has. Apply as a dependency bump in f5's web package.

topics.summary: Moves web from React 19.2.6 to 19.3.0. In 19.3, useEffectEvent inside memo and forwardRef components gets a fresh closure, which fixes stale handlers in the branch toolbar, composer workspace refresh and pending-question card. It also removes the useStableCallback workaround.
topics.title: Web moves to React 19.3, which fixes stale effect events in memo components
fix(mobile): sent steer and queued messages are marked like desktop (#21417)

suggestion.reason: Fixes provider update recovery after an incompatible Homebrew install. Reimplement it in f5's provider layer.

topics.summary: Before an explicit provider probe, installer maintenance metadata is read fresh, so Homebrew-managed providers stop reporting a stale incompatible latest version. Background checks stay cached.
topics.title: Explicit provider refresh re-reads installer metadata first

suggestion.reason: Small provider-status UX improvement in f5's provider settings.

topics.summary: When both the installed and the latest known Homebrew release are unsupported or broken, the compatibility message suggests brew update followed by the upgrade command.
topics.title: Incompatible Homebrew providers suggest running brew update

suggestion.reason: Orchestrating threads could stop hearing from their subagents. f5 has the same queue-hold behavior, so this needs reimplementing in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: After Stop or a restart holds the queue, a message the user sends now clears the hold, so subagent completion wakes queued behind it are delivered again. The mobile Resume control does not apply to f5.
topics.title: Sending a message resumes a held queue

suggestion.reason: This is a timeline UX change in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Delivered queued messages lose their marker. Steers keep '↪ Steer', and a queued message promoted to a steer still mentions in its tooltip that it was queued. The mobile changes do not apply to f5.
topics.title: Sent queued messages no longer show a 'From queue' marker

suggestion.reason: Removes a brief skeleton flash and some server work at publish in the HTML render frames, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Removes the outline skeleton from HTML render frames, along with the server's DOM outline extraction at publish. The frame now shows an empty box at its reserved height until the page loads.
topics.title: HTML renders drop the loading skeleton
fix(mobile): gallery images shrink back into their thumbnail on close (#21481)

suggestion.reason: Measurable rendering and scrolling performance gain in the timeline's changed-files tree, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Expanded changed-file trees with more than 250 files render only the visible rows plus a small overscan. The tree tracks the scroll viewport and resizes, and keeps focused rows mounted.
topics.title: Large changed-file trees are virtualized

suggestion.reason: Makes thread error banners easier to read.

topics.summary: For JSON errors, the collapsed error banner shows the nested error.message. 'Show full error' still shows the raw payload.
topics.title: Structured thread errors show their readable message in the banner

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale delegated-task status and incomplete cancellation in f5's subagent workflow.

topics.summary: Parent task cards update when delegated runs are queued, starting or finished. Recovery puts held runs back to idle, and cancelling a task removes its own queued run, even when the queue is held.
topics.title: Queued subagent task status stays in sync; cancel removes its queued run

suggestion.reason: Small UX improvement in the PR hub; port only the web presentation change.

topics.summary: Skipped pull request checks now show a slash icon, so they no longer look the same as neutral or cancelled checks. Only the web part applies to f5.
topics.title: Skipped PR checks use a slash icon

suggestion.reason: This is a composer UX fix. Agent-sent user messages also occur in f5 through delegation. Reimplement the attribution check without client-runtime.

topics.summary: Composer up-arrow recall now skips user-role messages that are attributed to an automation, another agent or T3 Code, using the same check as the 'Sent by' label. Only prompts the user typed are recalled.
topics.title: Up-arrow prompt recall skips automation and agent messages

suggestion.reason: Improves diagnostics for f5's desktop WSL backend.

topics.summary: When the mounted fallback also fails, the original WSL runtime installation error is reported, and fresh-install checks include loader stderr. Before, a misleading node-pty error was shown.
topics.title: WSL runtime installation errors are kept

suggestion.reason: Severe desktop preview browser bug. It applies if f5 has the PDF startup recovery that calls page.reload. GuestInput.ts is not at the same path in the fork.

topics.summary: Page.reload commands for the root page are handled with webContents.reload or reloadIgnoringCache instead of being sent through Electron's debugger. The debugger routed them to the embedder window, so opening a local PDF reloaded the app about once a second.
topics.title: PDF previews in the desktop Browser panel no longer reload the whole app

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken send shortcuts in narrow desktop windows.

topics.summary: The composer checks whether a software keyboard is open instead of the viewport width. Narrow or zoomed desktop windows keep Enter-to-send and no longer blur the editor after sending.
topics.title: Narrow desktop windows keep composer send shortcuts

topics.summary: The worktree setup card now renders branch, base, path and setup command below the action row instead of above it. The downward chevron matches where the content appears, and the action row no longer shifts when Details is toggled.
topics.title: Worktree setup Details open below their disclosure button
test(web): fix flaky attachment preview and ACP search tests (#21893)

suggestion.reason: Visual fix in the terminal renderer, if f5 uses the Ghostty web renderer.

topics.summary: The Ghostty web renderer fills U+E0B0 and U+E0B2 as triangles bounded by the cell instead of using font fallback, which left gaps between prompt segments.
topics.title: Terminal draws solid Powerline separators flush to the cell edges

suggestion.reason: Visual fix in the timeline and composer, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The timeline fades to transparent above the measured composer overlay height, so scrolled text no longer shows behind glass banners. The titlebar fade, scrollbar lane and minimap are unchanged.
topics.title: Timeline text no longer shows through translucent composer banners

suggestion.reason: Stops the composer from rewriting pasted code. Apply it to f5's mention tokenizer.

topics.summary: The inline-token parser skips bare identifier or dotted-member calls after @, so they are no longer turned into file chips. Quoted mentions and canonical file links still make chips.
topics.title: Pasted decorator calls like @foo(bar) stay as text instead of becoming file chips
fix(mobile): report rejected shared settings writes (#9356)

suggestion.reason: Visual bug fix in the preview browser's annotation editor, if f5 ships that editor.

topics.summary: The annotation CSS generator makes Tailwind's @property fallback defaults unconditional, because Chromium skips them inside a shadow root. The editor and toolbar get their borders, shadows, centering and focus underline back.
topics.title: Preview annotation editor shows its borders and shadows again

suggestion.reason: A one-prop fix for a settings UX bug.

topics.summary: Passes the filtered items to LegendList as extraData, so rows re-render with their current index. The first match is highlighted and Enter selects it.
topics.title: Font picker keyboard selection stays in sync while filtering
